Hippo’s Water Cycle Lab

Age 4–5 YearsClass 31 · ScienceSkill The water cycle

Evaporation, clouds, rain — number the three steps of water’s endless journey.

Play the science game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · THE WATER CYCLE

Hippo’s Water Cycle Lab

Water goes round and round! Tap the three steps in order: what happens FIRST, NEXT, and LAST?

Tap water’s journey in order — first to last.

The water cycle!

Evaporation lifts the water, clouds form, and rain falls down — then it all starts again!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

The water cycle is why we say rain “recycles” itself. Retell it at bath time: steam rises (evaporation!), a cool mirror makes fog (a cloud!), drops slide down (rain!).

Illustration note: Loaded by content: the file named penguins-hot-and-cold-lab actually carries this Hippo’s Water Cycle Lab artwork (the R2 export shifted files 20–30 by one slot). The panels sit in the order rain / evaporation / cloud formation; the true cycle order is evaporation first.

Prefer paper? The Hippo’s Water Cycle Lab worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
